"""mdata's frozen interface (docs/packages/mdata/contract.md): shape only, never a step's body."""

from __future__ import annotations

import dataclasses
import inspect
import re
import typing
from collections.abc import Callable, Mapping
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

import mdata
from mdata.types import GapError, Prices, RawRow

ISO_DATE = re.compile(r"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}")


def test_exports_exactly_the_contract() -> None:
    assert sorted(mdata.__all__) == [
        "GapError",
        "Prices",
        "RawRow",
        "align_calendar",
        "load_prices",
        "read_csv",
        "validate_rows",
    ]
    assert all(hasattr(mdata, name) for name in mdata.__all__)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("cls", "fields"),
    [
        (RawRow, {"date": str, "ticker": str, "close": float | None}),
        (
            Prices,
            {
                "dates": tuple[str, ...],
                "tickers": tuple[str, ...],
                "closes": Mapping[str, tuple[float, ...]],
            },
        ),
    ],
)
def test_types_are_frozen_dataclasses_with_the_contract_fields(
    cls: type, fields: dict[str, object]
) -> None:
    assert cls.__module__ == "mdata.types"
    assert cls.__dataclass_params__.frozen
    assert [f.name for f in dataclasses.fields(cls)] == list(fields)
    assert typing.get_type_hints(cls) == fields


def test_gap_error_is_a_value_error() -> None:
    assert issubclass(GapError, ValueError)
    assert GapError.__module__ == "mdata.types"


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("name", "module", "signature"),
    [
        ("read_csv", "mdata.io", "(path: str | pathlib.Path) -> list[mdata.types.RawRow]"),
        (
            "validate_rows",
            "mdata.validate",
            "(rows: collections.abc.Sequence[mdata.types.RawRow], "
            "tickers: collections.abc.Sequence[str] | None = None) -> list[mdata.types.RawRow]",
        ),
        (
            "align_calendar",
            "mdata.calendar",
            "(rows: collections.abc.Sequence[mdata.types.RawRow], *, max_gap: int = 5) "
            "-> mdata.types.Prices",
        ),
        (
            "load_prices",
            "mdata.pipeline",
            "(path: str | pathlib.Path, tickers: collections.abc.Sequence[str] | None = None) "
            "-> mdata.types.Prices",
        ),
    ],
)
def test_signatures_in_their_owner_modules(name: str, module: str, signature: str) -> None:
    fn = getattr(mdata, name)
    assert fn.__module__ == module
    assert str(inspect.signature(fn)) == signature


def test_raw_row_sample_fits_the_type(contract_sample: Callable[[str], dict]) -> None:
    rows = [RawRow(**row) for row in contract_sample("mdata.RawRow")["rows"]]
    assert len(rows) == 8
    assert len({row.ticker for row in rows}) == 2
    assert sum(row.close is None for row in rows) == 1
    for row in rows:
        assert ISO_DATE.fullmatch(row.date)
        assert row.close is None or isinstance(row.close, float)


def assert_prices_valid(prices: Prices) -> None:
    """mdata.Prices's invariants: dates ascending; tickers sorted; one positive close per date."""
    assert list(prices.dates) == sorted(set(prices.dates))
    assert all(ISO_DATE.fullmatch(d) for d in prices.dates)
    assert list(prices.tickers) == sorted(set(prices.tickers))
    assert set(prices.closes) == set(prices.tickers)
    for closes in prices.closes.values():
        assert len(closes) == len(prices.dates)
        assert all(isinstance(c, float) and c > 0 for c in closes)


def test_prices_sample_fits_the_type(
    contract_sample: Callable[[str], dict], contract_fake: Callable[[str], typing.Any]
) -> None:
    prices = contract_fake("mdata.load_prices").prices_from_json(contract_sample("mdata.Prices"))
    assert_prices_valid(prices)
    assert len(prices.tickers) == 2
    assert len(prices.dates) == 6


def assert_load_prices_contract(
    load_prices: Callable[..., Prices], csv: Path, expected: Prices
) -> None:
    """The mdata.load_prices cases, for any provider: the fake now, the real one once it is built."""
    assert load_prices(csv) == expected
    first = expected.tickers[0]
    one = load_prices(csv, [first])
    assert one.tickers == (first,)
    assert one.dates == expected.dates
    assert one.closes == {first: expected.closes[first]}
    with pytest.raises(KeyError, match="NOPE"):
        load_prices(csv, ["NOPE"])


def test_load_prices_fake_meets_the_contract(
    contract_sample: Callable[[str], dict], contract_fake: Callable[[str], typing.Any]
) -> None:
    fake = contract_fake("mdata.load_prices")
    assert_load_prices_contract(
        fake.load_prices, fake.CSV, fake.prices_from_json(contract_sample("mdata.Prices"))
    )
